def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    vals={}
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v!=0: vals[v]=vals.get(v,0)+1
    bg=max(vals,key=vals.get)
    marker=[v for v in vals if v!=bg]
    assert len(marker)==1
    m=marker[0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==m]
    ai,aj=min(pts)
    shape=[(i-ai,j-aj) for i,j in pts]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    occ=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if all(0<=i+di<H and 0<=j+dj<W and g[i+di][j+dj]==0 for di,dj in shape):
                occ.append((i,j))
    for i,j in occ:
        for di,dj in shape: out[i+di][j+dj]=m
    return out
# verify on demo
assert transform(inp)==out
